headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.1-modder.2
summary: Picking an accent color now recolors the animated background effect immediately in every theme and edit-mode combination.

items.text: Choosing an accent color in Settings → Personalize now refreshes the animated background effect right away, including while a different theme variant's edit tab is active; the effect previously kept the old palette until the next full screen rebuild.
